breakdown.description: Σ and ρ should be reciprocals, but 1/(2.0×10^-6 Ω·m) = 5.0×10^5 S/m, not 3.0×10^5 S/m.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the incorrect conductivity value (3.0×10^5 S/m) instead of removing/fixing it. Ground truth omits the incorrect sigma and asks to compute conductivity from resistivity alone (which would be 5.0×10^5 S/m). Therefore the inconsistency was not resolved.
